holdout_guard: New group wholly development; compare source/target SHA256 against all reserved metadata before parsing/rendering. Normalized duplication remains unknown. Reserved bytes stay unopened.
license_check: Pinned LICENSE read through web tool before acquisition; explicit MIT permission observed; exact native bytes will be verified/retained before any source packet distribution
population: Purpose-selected development convenience example; not population sampling
renderer_scope: Static repository Markdown as displayed on GitHub; no documentation-site expansion
revision_metadata: git ls-remote public tag14.1.0, one lightweight tag ref; verify commit identity before reading README
scope: One complete natural README plus exactly its supported Markdown target closure; no recursive source expansion
target_read_policy: Select target native paths from production static resolver before reading target bytes; bind Git blobs or verified pinned absence; no network target fetch
